preparation: Published coherent split packet and scalar Gaussian; one-edge pair normalized within its selected orbit mass; both density centers, 1/8 and 1/4. exp(i F4) once in the clock packet.
counting_candidates: equal coefficient per fully admissible marked history
coefficient proportional to inverse inner automorphism order per fully admissible marked history
support_check: Compare the normalized coefficient marginal with all inherited unordered positive N13 prefix classes in each N11 root. Also test arbitrary terminal-type-only linear coefficients if the marginal distinguishes two identical rows.
clock_readout: Unobserved first release of any inner event; cuts at 0 and 1/4 within the collars. Three disjoint intervals for the minimum of the two minimal event clocks. Recombine before taking the scalar Gram or q7 bins.
comparisons: Independent reference without intermediate cuts; split at 0 alone, at 1/4 alone, and both. On small grids check individual class amplitudes against the full Cartesian action.
numerics: Compare at successive inner and packet quadrature orders. Target 5e-9 absolute on each fine class amplitude and on the reconstructed complex endpoint Gram. Shift of weights is not fitted. No rigorous continuum enclosure.
scope: Conditional two-endpoint test; physical growth map, full norm and P3 admission remain open.
ideal_extension: Independently integrate all 14 exact ideal rectangles at each shifted cut, including the minimal excluded frontier and all free hidden clocks. Check exact occupancy counts, with two released events as the first occupancy separating the two geometries. Test each rectangle against a direct six-axis action on a small grid.
grid_orders: Whole ideal and first-release integrals at (32,6) and (48,8); additionally (64,10) for convergence. Absolute comparison against independently archived uncut endpoint packet.
